Why choose BE CUTE SPA in Rabat Agdal?

At BE CUTE SPA, the Moroccan hammam meets a massage menu designed around Rabat’s pace. From the start, every appointment is clear: the ritual, what it includes, its duration and its price.

In the heart of Agdal

Rue Aguelmane Sidi Ali, Rabat: an easy-to-reach address for an unhurried pause.

The Moroccan hammam ritual

Black soap, tebrima, exfoliation and ghassoul are listed treatment by treatment, so you know exactly what you are booking.

A clear treatment menu

Hammam rituals, relaxing and Swedish massage, back & neck care: durations and prices are shown plainly.

Experiences that linger

Signature packages combine a hammam and massage in one visit, from 500 DH.

Book in a few moments

Each treatment opens a pre-filled WhatsApp message; you can also call the spa directly.
